text:
Samir A: CI red on feature/async-cache after I rebased onto main this morning. linux-x86_64-shard-4 failed during unit tests. Anyone free to quick-check? cc @Maria K @Josh R
Maria K: pushed a rerun? link?
Samir A: here's the failing test output:
```text
FAIL testkv_prefetch::handles_missing_key
thread 'testkv_prefetch' panicked at 'assertion failed', tests/kv/prefetch.rs:112:15
stack backtrace: ...
Caused by: timeout waiting for prefetch to complete (expected <= 10ms, got 120ms)
```
CI Bot: Build #5823 (feature/async-cache) — linux-x86_64-shard-4 — failed. <https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5823> :red_circle:
Josh R: hmm looks like a timing assert. Possibly caused by the jemalloc tweak that landed on main yesterday. Can you try rerunning just that shard? @Olivia T can you kick the retry for shard-4?
Olivia T: kicked rerun for shard-4: <https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5823/retry> :rocket:
CI Bot: Rerun started (retry-id 5823-1). logs streaming to <https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5823/retry/logs>
Jen L: if the rerun flakes again we should bisect commits between the branch and main. Samir, can you paste `git log --oneline --graph --left-right feature/async-cache...origin/main | sed -n '1,20p'` (short) so we can see candidate commits?
Samir A: pasted trimmed output:
```
> abc1234 fix(kv): reduce prefetch timeout default
< def5678 perf(jemalloc): arena tweak for allocator
> 901abcd feat(async): initial async cache proto
> 77aabb test(kv): add new prefetch unit tests
```
Ryan P: I can run a local bisect if rerun stays red. Suggested bisect flow:
`git checkout feature/async-cache`
`git bisect start origin/main HEAD`
`git bisect run ./ci/scripts/ci_run_one.sh --test TestKVPrefetch`
CI Bot: Rerun finished: PASS :white_check_mark: (shard-4). Build #5823 now green.
Samir A: awesome, thanks all. I'll merge the rebase and keep an eye on the flaky window. If it recurs I'll coordinate with @Ryan P to bisect.
Maria K: marking as resolved on our end. :thumbsup:
